name: Crimson Prison
source:
One fateful day, in a remote alley of Sumairu-Urbem, a homeless girl is kidnapped and sent to an Underground Prison for death matches... Nuevo Faredo's Prison.

Your mission —as a retired mentor—  is to train her in using her new energies and protect her so she does not die in her first fight, while searching for a way to secure her freedom.

Hundreds of inmates are brought in every year, and hundreds more are left forgotten beneath the cold earth.

Will you be able to protect her while strengthening your party to root out the evil that plagues the inmates' hearts? I believe in your judgment.

[From [url=https://dajimess.itch.io/crimson-prison]itch.io[/url]]
